title: Cash Back or Points: The Honest Fork in the Road
caption:
Venture X + Amex Gold, or a cash-back daily driver? Choose based on the homework you’ll actually do.

Points are program units, not dollars. Transferring means moving eligible rewards to a partner loyalty program, then booking through that program. That can produce higher value—but requires checking availability, cash charges and terms.

The measuring stick is cents per point (cpp): realistic cash savings after booking charges, divided by points used, expressed in cents. Portals aren’t automatically worthless; transfers aren’t automatically winners.

Compare the full card costs against spending you’d actually replace. Will you research bookings, or would you rather take the cash?
